audience: e-commerce merchants who handle return and exchange requests in Return Prime

useCases.title: Check the status of one return or exchange
useCases.text: Look up a return or exchange by its request number. Read its status, type, order and customer.

useCases.title: List the return requests of a date range
useCases.text: List the return and exchange requests created in a date range. Filter by request type to see only returns or only exchanges.

useCases.title: Find a request by its tracking number
useCases.text: Search the requests by the tracking number (AWB) of the parcel. Then read the order and customer of each match.

useCases.title: Review the requests of one customer
useCases.text: Filter the requests by customer. Then read the status and order of each request to answer the customer's question.
